# Edgecase SecondLook

Independent pre-action review for AI agents.

- Site: https://secondlook.edgecasesystems.com/
- API: https://secondlook.edgecasesystems.workers.dev/
- OpenAPI: https://secondlook.edgecasesystems.workers.dev/openapi.json
- Boundary: SecondLook reviews intended actions but never authorizes, executes, or supplies missing authority.
- Statuses: no_material_concern_found, material_concern_found, insufficient_information, human_review_required
